# S01: Project Scaffold and Tooling

**Goal:** Vite + Electron + React + TypeScript project compiles and renders an empty window. ESLint, Prettier, Vitest, and Playwright configured. pi resolver written and tested.
**Demo:** pnpm dev opens an empty Electron window. pnpm test passes. pnpm lint passes.

## Must-Haves

- Complete the planned slice outcomes.

## Verification

- Run the task and slice verification checks for this slice.

<tasks>
- [ ] **T01**: Project bootstrap _(4h)_
  Scaffold the monorepo using electron-vite (https://electron-vite.org). Structure: main/, preload/, renderer/, shared/, test/. Install deps: electron, vite, react, react-dom, typescript, @types/react, @types/node, @opengsd/rpc-client, @opengsd/contracts, zustand, tailwindcss, @radix-ui/react-* (as needed per phase), eslint, prettier, vitest, @playwright/test, electron-builder. tsconfig: strict, paths alias @shared -> shared/, @main -> main/, @renderer -> renderer/. Verify: pnpm dev opens an empty Electron window with contextIsolation:true, nodeIntegration:false, sandbox:true.
  - Files: `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `tsconfig.main.json`, `tsconfig.renderer.json`, `electron.vite.config.ts`, `vite.config.ts`, `.eslintrc.json`, `.prettierrc`, `vitest.config.ts`, `playwright.config.ts`, `main/index.ts`, `preload/preload.ts`, `renderer/main.tsx`, `renderer/App.tsx`, `shared/types.ts`
  - Verify: pnpm dev opens empty window. pnpm test passes (no tests yet, suite exits 0). pnpm lint passes.
- [ ] **T02**: pi resolver _(2h)_
  Implement resolvePiBinary() in main/pi/resolve-pi.ts. Resolution order: (1) GSD_PI_PATH env var, (2) 'gsd' on PATH via which/where, (3) common install locations (%APPDATA%/npm/gsd.cmd, %LOCALAPPDATA%/fnm/...). Throws ResolvePiError with an actionable message if not found. Export resolvePiBinary() and ResolvePiError. Write Vitest unit tests covering: PATH hit, env var override, not-found error, malformed env var path.
  - Files: `main/pi/resolve-pi.ts`, `main/pi/resolve-pi.test.ts`
  - Verify: pnpm test -- resolve-pi passes all 4 cases.
</tasks>

# S02: pi Client and Event Pump

**Goal:** RpcClient factory creates and inits a client against a real gsd install. SessionHandle subscribes to the event stream and fans events to an EventEmitter.
**Demo:** Node script opens a client, sends a prompt, prints every event to stdout, closes cleanly.

## Must-Haves

- Complete the planned slice outcomes.

## Verification

- Run the task and slice verification checks for this slice.

<tasks>
- [ ] **T03**: RpcClient factory _(2h)_
  Implement createClient({ cwd, binary? }) in main/pi/client-factory.ts. Uses resolvePiBinary() if binary not provided. Creates RpcClient, calls client.start() then client.init(). Returns a started, init'd client. Logs protocolVersion on init. On init failure throws ClientInitError with pi version and upgrade hint. Write Vitest unit test with mocked RpcClient verifying start() then init() are called in order. Reference the RPC contract at C:/nvm4w/nodejs/node_modules/@opengsd/gsd-pi/packages/contracts/dist/rpc.d.ts (read with the read tool, not imported).
  - Files: `main/pi/client-factory.ts`, `main/pi/client-factory.test.ts`, `shared/types.ts`
  - Verify: pnpm test -- client-factory passes. Manual: node -e script opens a client against a real gsd install and prints protocolVersion.
- [ ] **T04**: SessionHandle and event pump _(3h)_
  Implement SessionHandle in main/session/session-handle.ts. Constructor takes a started RpcClient and a sessionId. start() launches an unawaited async pump: for await (const ev of client.events()) { emitter.emit('event', ev) }. Handles agent_start, agent_end, message, text_delta, tool_use, tool_result as typed events. All other types are logged at debug and emitted as unknown-event. Pump catches transport errors and emits transport-error. Throttle text_delta to 60fps (16ms debounce) before IPC fan-out. Expose: start(), stop(), on(), sessionId, clientState.
  - Files: `main/session/session-handle.ts`, `main/session/session-handle.test.ts`
  - Verify: pnpm test -- session-handle passes. Manual: open client, start pump, send prompt, observe all event types printed.
</tasks>

## Files Likely Touched

- main/pi/client-factory.ts
- main/pi/client-factory.test.ts
- shared/types.ts
- main/session/session-handle.ts
- main/session/session-handle.test.ts

# S03: Session State Machine and Manager

**Goal:** Minimal 3-state machine (Working / Idle / Stopped). SessionManager wraps handles with stable IDs. Phase-1 restriction: one session at a time.
**Demo:** State machine unit tests pass for all valid transitions.

## Must-Haves

- Complete the planned slice outcomes.

## Verification

- Run the task and slice verification checks for this slice.

<tasks>
- [ ] **T05**: Minimal state machine _(2h)_
  Implement SessionStateMachine in main/session/state-machine.ts. States: Working | Idle | Stopped. Transitions: agent_start -> Working; agent_end (no blockers) -> Idle; transport-error | watchdog-timeout -> Stopped. Watchdog: if state is Working and no event for 30s, emit watchdog-timeout. Emits state-changed event on every transition. Write Vitest unit tests covering all transitions including the watchdog.
  - Files: `main/session/state-machine.ts`, `main/session/state-machine.test.ts`
  - Verify: pnpm test -- state-machine passes all transitions including watchdog timeout.
- [ ] **T06**: SessionManager _(2h)_
  Implement SessionManager in main/session/session-manager.ts. Phase-1: max one session (throws if open() called while one is active). Methods: open(cwd) -> SessionHandle, get(id), close(id). open() calls createClient, constructs SessionHandle, starts it, assigns a stable id (s_ + nanoid). close() calls handle.stop() then client.shutdown() with 3s timeout fallback to client.stop(). Tracks session in a Map. Write Vitest unit tests with mocked createClient.
  - Files: `main/session/session-manager.ts`, `main/session/session-manager.test.ts`
  - Verify: pnpm test -- session-manager passes. open() -> get() -> close() lifecycle works with mocked client.
</tasks>

- main/session/state-machine.test.ts
- main/session/session-manager.ts
- main/session/session-manager.test.ts

# S04: IPC Bridge and Preload

**Goal:** Main-process IPC handlers and preload bridge. Renderer can call openProject, prompt, abort, getState and receive session:event and session:state-change.
**Demo:** DevTools console: window.gsd.prompt('hello') returns a response streamed via events.

## Must-Haves

- Complete the planned slice outcomes.

## Verification

- Run the task and slice verification checks for this slice.

<tasks>
- [ ] **T07**: IPC handlers _(3h)_
  Implement IPC handlers in main/ipc/handlers.ts. Register ipcMain handlers for: openProject(cwd) -> opens a session, returns sessionId; prompt(sessionId, text) -> calls client.prompt(); abort(sessionId) -> calls client.abort(); getState(sessionId) -> returns current SessionState. Fan out session events to all focused webContents via webContents.send('session:event', ...) and state changes via webContents.send('session:state-change', ...). Throttle text_delta fan-out to 60fps. Write Vitest unit tests with mocked SessionManager and mocked webContents.
  - Files: `main/ipc/handlers.ts`, `main/ipc/handlers.test.ts`
  - Verify: pnpm test -- ipc/handlers passes. DevTools: ipcRenderer.invoke('openProject', cwd) returns a sessionId.
- [ ] **T08**: Preload bridge _(2h)_
  Implement preload/preload.ts. Uses contextBridge to expose window.gsd with: openProject(cwd), prompt(sessionId, text), abort(sessionId), getState(sessionId), onEvent(sessionId, cb) -> unsubscribe fn, onStateChange(sessionId, cb) -> unsubscribe fn. All types defined in shared/types.ts. Renderer imports only from shared/types.ts, never from main/. Verify contextIsolation is on and no Node API leaks to renderer.
  - Files: `preload/preload.ts`, `shared/types.ts`
  - Verify: DevTools: window.gsd exists. window.require is undefined. window.process is undefined. window.gsd.onEvent returns an unsubscribe function.
</tasks>

- main/ipc/handlers.test.ts
- preload/preload.ts
- shared/types.ts

# S05: Renderer Chat View

**Goal:** Turn list with streaming assistant messages, tool cards, and composer. Folder picker on startup stores cwd in memory.
**Demo:** Full chat turn visible: user message, streaming assistant text, tool card.

## Must-Haves

- Complete the planned slice outcomes.

## Verification

- Run the task and slice verification checks for this slice.

<tasks>
- [ ] **T09**: Renderer chat view _(3h)_
  Implement renderer/App.tsx as a single chat view. On mount: show a folder picker (ipcRenderer dialog or window.gsd.openProject via a click). Store the selected cwd and sessionId in component state. Render a turn list: each turn has a user bubble and an assistant section. Assistant section streams text_delta events as they arrive (append to current turn). Composer at bottom: textarea, Enter sends, Shift+Enter inserts newline. No routing, no tabs, no persistence. Style with Tailwind, minimal but readable.

  Add a ToolCard component in renderer/components/ToolCard.tsx. Shows tool name, input summary (first 80 chars of the input JSON), and collapsed result. Expand/collapse on click. Handles tool_use event (shows name + pending state) then tool_result event (fills result, removes pending). Supports all tool names without special-casing. No external libraries for this component.
  - Files: `renderer/components/ToolCard.tsx`, `renderer/App.tsx`

# S06: Shutdown and Smoke Test

**Goal:** Clean shutdown on window close. Playwright smoke test passes 10 consecutive runs with no pi-child leaks.
**Demo:** Playwright test run passes 10 consecutive times.

## Must-Haves

- Complete the planned slice outcomes.

## Verification

- Run the task and slice verification checks for this slice.

<tasks>
- [ ] **T11**: Clean shutdown _(2h)_
  Handle app shutdown in main/index.ts. On before-quit: call sessionManager.close(id) for every open session. SessionManager.close() calls client.shutdown() with a 3s Promise.race timeout then falls back to client.stop() (force-kill). Log shutdown sequence with timing. Prevent window close until all sessions closed via app.on('before-quit') + event.preventDefault(). If shutdown takes >5s total log error and allow quit anyway.
  - Files: `main/index.ts`, `main/session/session-manager.ts`
  - Verify: Close window -> Task Manager shows gsd.exe exits within 3s. Repeat 10 times.
- [ ] **T12**: Playwright smoke test _(3h)_
  Write Playwright smoke test in test/smoke.spec.ts using @playwright/test _electron API. Create test/fixtures/sample-project/ as a minimal git repo with only a package.json (no .gsd/ needed). Steps: launch app via _electron.launch(); wait for folder picker; select fixture path; wait for Idle state; type 'say hello in exactly three words' in composer; press Enter; wait for assistant text with at least 2 words; assert zero console errors. Verify zero gsd.exe processes remain after each run via pwsh Get-Process check.
  - Files: `test/smoke.spec.ts`, `test/fixtures/sample-project/package.json`, `playwright.config.ts`
  - Verify: pnpm test:e2e passes 10 consecutive runs. Get-Process gsd returns nothing after each run.
</tasks>

- test/smoke.spec.ts

# S01: Contract Types and BlockerTracker

**Goal:** Shared contract types for UI requests/responses. BlockerTracker records open requests and emits add/remove. State machine gains Waiting on you.
**Demo:** Session state shows Waiting on you in DevTools when a blocker is injected via mock.

## Must-Haves

- Complete the planned slice outcomes.

## Verification

- Run the task and slice verification checks for this slice.

<tasks>
- [ ] **T01**: Contract types _(1h)_
  In shared/types.ts, import and re-export RpcExtensionUIRequest and RpcExtensionUIResponse from @opengsd/contracts. Define UiRequestState (map of requestId -> request) and UiResponseInput. Keep renderer-safe: types only, no runtime imports from @opengsd/contracts in renderer bundle. Verify renderer tsconfig can import from shared/types.ts without pulling in Node types.
  - Files: `shared/types.ts`
  - Verify: pnpm tsc --noEmit passes with no errors in renderer tsconfig.
- [ ] **T02**: BlockerTracker _(1.5h)_
  Implement BlockerTracker in main/session/blocker-tracker.ts. Maintains a Map<requestId, RpcExtensionUIRequest> per session. Methods: add(req), remove(requestId), getAll(), size(). Emits ui-request-added and ui-request-removed events. Write Vitest unit tests: add/remove round trip, multiple blockers, remove non-existent id (no-op).
  - Files: `main/session/blocker-tracker.ts`, `main/session/blocker-tracker.test.ts`
  - Verify: pnpm test -- blocker-tracker passes all cases.
- [ ] **T03**: State machine Waiting state _(2h)_
  Extend SessionStateMachine in main/session/state-machine.ts to add the Waiting on you state. New transitions: blocker-added -> Waiting (from any non-Stopped state); blocker-removed AND blockerCount==0 AND agent active -> Working; blocker-removed AND blockerCount==0 AND agent idle -> Idle. SessionHandle wires BlockerTracker events into the state machine. Update all existing state machine tests; add new tests for the Waiting transitions.
  - Files: `main/session/state-machine.ts`, `main/session/state-machine.test.ts`, `main/session/session-handle.ts`
  - Verify: pnpm test -- state-machine passes all transitions including new Waiting paths.
</tasks>

# S01: Registry Store and Schema Types

**Goal:** Atomic JSON registry store with .bak fallback. SessionRecord, WindowRecord, RegistryV1 types defined.
**Demo:** Unit tests: write registry, kill process mid-write, relaunch reads .bak, no data loss.

## Must-Haves

- Complete the planned slice outcomes.

## Verification

- Run the task and slice verification checks for this slice.

<tasks>
- [ ] **T01**: Registry schema types _(1h)_
  Define RegistryV1, SessionRecord, WindowRecord in shared/types.ts. SessionRecord: { id, cwd, displayName, sessionFile?, lastOpenedAt, wasAutoRunning }. WindowRecord: { id, tabIds: string[], activeTabId, bounds: {x,y,width,height} }. RegistryV1: { version: 1, sessions: SessionRecord[], windows: WindowRecord[], mruOrder: string[] }. Version field enables future migration.
  - Files: `shared/types.ts`

tasks.title: BlockerTracker
tasks.description: Implement BlockerTracker in main/session/blocker-tracker.ts. Maintains a Map<requestId, RpcExtensionUIRequest> per session. Methods: add(req), remove(requestId), getAll(), size(). Emits ui-request-added and ui-request-removed events. Write Vitest unit tests: add/remove round trip, multiple blockers, remove non-existent id (no-op).
tasks.verify: pnpm test -- blocker-tracker passes all cases.

tasks.title: State machine Waiting state
tasks.description: Extend SessionStateMachine in main/session/state-machine.ts to add the Waiting on you state. New transitions: blocker-added -> Waiting (from any non-Stopped state); blocker-removed AND blockerCount==0 AND agent active -> Working; blocker-removed AND blockerCount==0 AND agent idle -> Idle. SessionHandle wires BlockerTracker events into the state machine. Update all existing state machine tests; add new tests for the Waiting transitions.
tasks.verify: pnpm test -- state-machine passes all transitions including new Waiting paths.

tasks.title: respondUI IPC handler
tasks.description: Add respondUI(sessionId, requestId, response) IPC handler in main/ipc/handlers.ts. Validates response shape matches the recorded request method (e.g. select requires a string value, confirm requires boolean). Calls client.sendUIResponse(). Removes the blocker from BlockerTracker on success. Returns an error payload (never throws to renderer) on validation failure. Extend IPC fan-out to also send session:ui-request-added and session:ui-request-removed to webContents. Write Vitest unit tests for validation logic and happy path.
tasks.verify: pnpm test -- ipc/handlers passes validation and happy-path cases.

tasks.title: Windows notifications
tasks.description: Implement main/os/notifications.ts. Set AppUserModelID 'io.opengsd.gsd-tau' on app ready (required for Windows toast attribution). Expose showBlockerToast(sessionName, method): creates an Electron Notification with title 'gsd-tau needs input' and body '{sessionName}: {method}'. Debounce per-session: max one toast per session per 3s. Toast click event calls app.focus() + mainWindow.show(). Write a manual test script that fires a toast and verifies it appears.
tasks.verify: Run manual test script: toast appears within 500ms. Clicking it focuses the app window. AppUserModelID is set (verify via PowerShell Get-StartApps).

tasks.title: Modal: select
tasks.description: Implement renderer/components/modals/SelectModal.tsx. Renders radio buttons for single-select or checkboxes for multi-select (when allowMultiple is true). Has a Confirm button and a Cancel button. Cancel sends { cancelled: true }. Confirm sends { value: selectedOption } or { values: selectedOptions[] }. Preview field (markdown) shown alongside the option when present. Accessible: keyboard navigable, focus trapped in modal.
tasks.verify: Render with mock request: single-select shows radio buttons, multi-select shows checkboxes. Confirm sends correct value. Cancel sends cancelled:true.

tasks.title: Modals: confirm, input, editor
tasks.description: Implement renderer/components/modals/ConfirmModal.tsx (Yes/No buttons), renderer/components/modals/InputModal.tsx (single-line text field; if secure:true uses type=password and never logs value), and renderer/components/modals/EditorModal.tsx (multi-line monospace textarea; Ctrl+Enter submits). All three follow the same Cancel -> cancelled:true pattern.
tasks.verify: Confirm: Yes/No both send correct boolean. Input: text sent on submit, masked when secure. Editor: Ctrl+Enter submits, plain Enter inserts newline.

tasks.title: Non-modal renderers
tasks.description: Implement renderer/components/StatusBar.tsx that renders setStatus, setWidget, and setTitle payloads in a persistent status region below the session header. Implement renderer/components/InlineToast.tsx for notify payloads: auto-dismisses after 4s, stacks up to 3, oldest dismissed first when overflow. Implement set_editor_text by pre-filling the active EditorModal if one is open, otherwise buffering for the next open.
tasks.verify: setStatus updates status bar text. notify shows toast that auto-dismisses. Multiple notifys stack correctly.

tasks.title: Modal queue and fallback modal
tasks.description: Implement a modal queue in renderer/state/modal-queue.ts (Zustand slice). When multiple ui-request-added events arrive, queue them. Active modal is queue[0]; a badge on the session tab shows queue.length when >1. When active modal is answered, shift the queue and show the next. Implement renderer/components/modals/FallbackModal.tsx: shows raw request JSON in a read-only code block, a plain text input for the response, and Cancel. Used for any unknown method value.
tasks.verify: Inject two simultaneous blockers via mock: second queues behind first. Queue badge shows 2. Answering first immediately shows second. FallbackModal renders for method='unknown_future_method'.

tasks.title: Shutdown cancellation
tasks.description: Extend main/index.ts shutdown sequence: before calling client.shutdown(), iterate BlockerTracker.getAll() for each session and call client.sendUIResponse({ requestId, cancelled: true }) for each. Wait for all cancellation acks (or 2s timeout per session). Log each cancellation with requestId and timing. Write Vitest unit test: mock session with 2 open blockers, trigger shutdown, assert 2 cancellations sent before shutdown() call.
tasks.verify: pnpm test -- shutdown-cancel passes. Manual: open a confirm modal, quit app, check pi logs show cancelled:true received.

tasks.title: Playwright UI-request tests
tasks.description: Write Playwright e2e tests in test/ui-requests.spec.ts. Use a mock pi server (local TCP or stdio mock) that emits each request method in sequence. Test cases: (1) select single and multi, (2) confirm yes and no, (3) input plain and secure, (4) editor submit and cancel, (5) notify+setStatus non-modal render, (6) two simultaneous blockers queue correctly, (7) quit with open confirm modal sends cancellation. Each test asserts the correct response was received by the mock pi.
tasks.verify: pnpm test:e2e -- ui-requests passes all 7 test cases. Zero pi-child leaks after 20 runs with unanswered blockers.

tasks.title: Registry schema types
tasks.description: Define RegistryV1, SessionRecord, WindowRecord in shared/types.ts. SessionRecord: { id, cwd, displayName, sessionFile?, lastOpenedAt, wasAutoRunning }. WindowRecord: { id, tabIds: string[], activeTabId, bounds: {x,y,width,height} }. RegistryV1: { version: 1, sessions: SessionRecord[], windows: WindowRecord[], mruOrder: string[] }. Version field enables future migration.
tasks.verify: pnpm tsc --noEmit passes. Types imported in both main and renderer tsconfigs without error.

tasks.title: RegistryStore
tasks.description: Implement RegistryStore in main/persistence/registry-store.ts. load(): reads %APPDATA%/gsd-tau/registry.json; on parse error falls back to .bak; on both fail returns getDefault(). save(registry): debounced 500ms; writes to registry.tmp then renames to registry.json; copies previous to .bak before rename. getDefault() returns empty RegistryV1. Vitest tests: normal round-trip; .bak corruption recovery; mid-write kill simulation (write .tmp, skip rename, reload); version field preserved across save/load.
tasks.verify: pnpm test -- registry-store passes all 4 scenarios including mid-write kill simulation.

tasks.title: Multi-session SessionManager
tasks.description: Remove the Phase-1 single-session restriction from SessionManager. Upgrade open(cwd, opts?) to allow N concurrent sessions. Assign each a stable id (s_ + nanoid). Track all in a Map<id, SessionHandle>. Add list() -> SessionRecord[], rename(id, name), and a getRegistry() helper that builds a RegistryV1 snapshot from live session state. Every open/close/rename/state-change event triggers registryStore.save() (debounced). Write Vitest unit tests: open 3 sessions, verify all tracked; close one, verify map shrinks; rename, verify displayName updated in getRegistry() snapshot.
tasks.verify: pnpm test -- session-manager passes including 3-session open/close/rename cycle.

tasks.title: Session restore on launch
tasks.description: Implement restore flow: on app ready, RegistryStore.load() returns the last session list. For each SessionRecord with wasAutoRunning=true, call sessionManager.open(cwd) with switch_session strategy: call client.switch_session(sessionFile) if sessionFile is present, otherwise treat as fresh start. Mark restored sessions with isRestored flag in SessionHandle metadata. Emit restore-complete IPC event when all restores attempted (success or failure).
tasks.verify: Open 2 sessions, quit, relaunch — both appear in session list. switch_session is called for sessions that have a sessionFile.

tasks.title: Single-instance lock and multi-session IPC
tasks.description: Implement single-instance lock in main/index.ts via app.requestSingleInstanceLock(). Second-instance handler: parse argv for --open-project <path>, send openProject IPC to the first instance's main window, then quit. First instance receives the forwarded path and calls sessionManager.open(). Extend IPC handlers with: listSessions() -> SessionRecord[], openProject(cwd), closeSession(id), renameSession(id, name). Write Vitest test for arg parsing logic.
tasks.verify: Launch two instances with --open-project: second exits, first opens new tab. listSessions() returns all open sessions.

tasks.title: Zustand sessions store
tasks.description: Create renderer/state/sessions-store.ts (Zustand). State: sessions: Map<id, SessionState>, activeTabId: string | null, tabOrder: string[]. Actions: openTab(cwd), closeTab(id), setActiveTab(id), reorderTabs(ids), renameTab(id, name). Sync from IPC: subscribe to session:state-change, session:ui-request-added/removed, restore-complete. On app ready: call listSessions() and populate store from registry. Write Vitest tests for all actions and the IPC sync logic (mock ipcRenderer).
tasks.verify: pnpm test -- sessions-store passes all action and IPC sync cases.

tasks.title: Tab bar
tasks.description: Implement renderer/components/TabBar.tsx. Each tab shows: session displayName (truncated to 24 chars), state indicator dot (Working=yellow pulse, Waiting=orange, Idle=green, Stopped=red), blocker queue badge when >0. Interactions: click=setActiveTab, middle-click=closeTab (confirm if Working), right-click=context menu (Rename, Close, Move to new window — Move deferred to Phase 6). Drag to reorder via HTML5 drag-and-drop. Plus button opens New Session or the Open Project flyout. Keyboard: Ctrl+T new tab, Ctrl+W close active, Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab cycle.
tasks.verify: All tab interactions work. Drag reorders. Right-click menu appears. State dots update live. Keyboard shortcuts work.

tasks.title: Open Project flyout
tasks.description: Implement renderer/components/OpenProjectFlyout.tsx. Opens on + button click or Ctrl+T. Shows: recent projects (MRU-10 from registry mruOrder), a folder picker button (calls openProject IPC), and a drag-and-drop zone (accepts dragged folder from Explorer). Recent items show last-opened relative time and a dismiss x. Keyboard: arrow keys navigate recents, Enter opens, Escape closes.
tasks.verify: Flyout shows correct recents. Folder picker opens native dialog. Drag-and-drop from Explorer opens a new tab. Escape closes.

tasks.title: SessionView with preserved state
tasks.description: Implement renderer/components/SessionView.tsx. Mounts the existing chat view (TurnList + Composer + StatusBar + modals) scoped to a sessionId. All state (turn history, streaming text, pending tool cards, modal queue, status bar) is per-sessionId in the Zustand store — switching tabs preserves prior session state. Unmounted session views are kept in the VDOM as hidden (display:none) to preserve scroll position; do not unmount them.
tasks.verify: Switch tabs and back: scroll position, turn history, and in-progress tool cards are preserved. Modal queue state is not lost on tab switch.

tasks.title: Missing-session-file banner
tasks.description: Implement missing-session-file detection: when a session restore fails because cwd no longer exists, emit session:missing-path event. SessionView renders a MissingSessionBanner above the chat: shows the old path, Locate button (opens native folder picker to reassign cwd), and Remove button (removes from registry, closes tab). Banner is dismissable. Locate updates the SessionRecord in registry and retries open().
tasks.verify: Delete fixture project dir, relaunch: banner appears with correct path. Locate reassigns. Remove closes the tab cleanly.

tasks.title: Window bounds persistence
tasks.description: Persist and restore window bounds in main/index.ts. On window move/resize (debounced 1s): read WindowRecord from registry, update bounds, save. On launch: read WindowRecord bounds and call new BrowserWindow({ ...savedBounds }). If saved bounds are off-screen (multi-monitor unplug scenario) clamp to the nearest display's workArea using screen.getAllDisplays().
tasks.verify: Resize window, quit, relaunch: window opens at same position and size. Simulate off-screen bounds: window clamps to visible area.

tasks.title: Playwright reboot-cycle test
tasks.description: Write Playwright e2e test test/reboot-cycle.spec.ts. Steps: launch app; open 3 fixture projects (fixtures/project-a, fixtures/project-b, fixtures/project-c); wait for all Idle; quit; relaunch; assert all 3 tabs present by displayName; assert active tab matches last active before quit. Create the 3 fixture dirs (minimal package.json each). Run 5 full cycles in CI.
tasks.verify: pnpm test:e2e -- reboot-cycle passes 5 consecutive cycles. Registry file intact and uncorrupted after each cycle.
